top_signals.title: Traders Trim October Fed Hike Bets After Soft Inflation Reading
top_signals.summary: Traders pared back their expectations for the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates in October after the central bank’s preferred measure of inflation accelerated by less than expected.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: EIA Reports Crude Build as Diesel Stocks Fall 14% Below Average
top_signals.summary: Crude oil inventories in the United States saw an increase of 900,000 barrels during the week ending September 25, according to new data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) released on Wednesday. The increase brings commercial stockpiles to 427.3 million barrels, according to government data, which is now 2% above the five-year average for this time of year. The EIA’s data release follows API’s figures that were released a day earlier, which reported that crude oil inventories had gained 1.019 million barrels in the…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Dubai to Tel Aviv Flight Averts Catastrophe After Pilots Fight
top_signals.summary: A flight operated by FlyDubai from Dubai to Tel Aviv narrowly avoided catastrophe after one of the pilots stabbed his colleague with the intent of bringing down the plane. The plane made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia. (Source: Bloomberg)
